text:
We just got a puppy, and needed a way to track potties to help us with house training. So, with AI/Claude's help, I found a similar open source package (Baby Buddy), forked it, and very quickly made it my own. Self-hosted, local for privacy reasons.

Repo: https://github.com/viciousnemesis/housetrained

Puppy: https://imgur.com/piDE0gq
